{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm (since we're computing mean flipper length)
# This is necessary because mean is undefined if we include NaN
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = penguins_clean.groupby('species', as_index=False)['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Sort by mean flipper length in descending order and get the top species
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.loc[mean_flipper_by_species['flipper_length_mm'].idxmax()]['species']

# Print results
print(mean_flipper_by_species)
print(f"Species with highest mean flipper length: {highest_mean_species}")"}
